annotations.title: Refuse Unsupported Mortgage Approval or Underwriting Requests

description: Returns a fixed explanation that a request is outside this calculator's scope, with a calculation it can do instead. Categories: approval or underwriting decisions, lender or product recommendations, borrower documents or accounts, current rates, rules, or thresholds, external actions such as submitting applications or contacting anyone, and other unsupported requests. Takes only the category; it accepts no request text, names, identifiers, or document content.

requestType.description: Category of unsupported request. Only the category is accepted, never user, borrower, account, or document data.

name: refuse_unsupported_mortgage_request

dataHandling.const: No user prompt, document, account, or borrower data was accepted or processed.
